summary: A cap module that replaces the stock lid of a 32 oz Nalgene wide-mouth bottle and reports how much water is left and how warm it is, reminds the user to drink with a light ring, and syncs readings over Wi-Fi.
features: Water level and temperature measured from the cap, with nothing in the bottle but a sealed stainless probe
A ring of 8 RGB LEDs for reminders and status, and one button
Wi-Fi sync, with provisioning over Bluetooth LE
A 1000 mAh LiPo cell charged from USB-C through an IP67 receptacle; target of 30 days or more between charges
A printed PETG cap that seals on the bottle's lip; hand wash only, no ingress rating claimed

functions.text: Measure the water level from the cap by time of flight to the surface
functions.by: VL53L4CD looking down through a window

functions.text: Measure the temperature inside the bottle with a sealed stainless probe
functions.by: DS18B20 probe through the cap floor

functions.text: Show reminders and status on a ring of RGB LEDs
functions.by: LP5024 driving 8 RGB LEDs, light guide in the cap

functions.text: Sync readings to a server over Wi-Fi; provision over BLE
Charge from USB-C; update firmware over USB or Wi-Fi
functions.by: MCP73831, IP67 USB-C receptacle, ESP32-C3 USB Serial/JTAG

functions.text: One button: wake, show level, pairing
functions.by: Side-push tact switch behind a sealed plunger
